diagnosis_limitations: Model input retained three latest signals and one numeric row, omitting 25 numeric rows.
Earlier disk-temporary-table, statement-time and rows-examined signals were absent from the selected input signals.
The one numeric row did contain actual official disk temporary table rate near 4/s, but the model did not use it in its explanation.
The report offers latency/QPS correlation and generic lock checks; it does not identify the temporary-table mechanism.
No observed request errors; this run must not be described as an outage.
The user-facing read-only actions expose the internal identifier nonempty_lock_snapshot and overemphasize lock checks without supporting lock evidence.
